authorizationChange: Retain all commercial legacy and P0A permissions. Modular owner-only manual corrections require immutable original amounts, atomic compensation/replacement, exact session counters and new ledger; workers cannot correct. Runtime preparation is create-only in migrating READY_TO_CUTOVER and requires exact administrative source/build/plan/device/journal/business/record/summary approval; never activates a writer. Runtime and cutover approvals are private per-owner records, never globally readable policy payloads; only platform administrators write them. Operational cutover still requires its separate administrative approval. Scoped worker authority validates the same exact owner contract and root identity against getAfter(root), allowing root activation and all business proofs in one atomic transaction; this does not require every owner client to publish every proof, and missing proof remains fail-closed for workers.
